title: The First Mission
summary: Trapped inside the ancient subterranean chamber beneath Saint Mirren, Ha-Jun faces the Blood Trial against three colossal Sovereign Guardian Golems. Shattering the stone guardians with his demonic gauntlet, his synchronization jumps to 15%—revealing the second ancient relic: The Ring of Hollow Blood.

panels.action: Ha-Jun descends the ancient spiral staircase; each step echoes into the vast, hollow darkness below.

panels.shot: wall texture shift to ancient basalt
panels.action: The walls transition from 1920s brickwork into ancient, prehistoric black basalt carved with glowing demonic glyphs.

dialogue.text: Insaani imarat ke neeche... daityon ka yug zinda tha.

panels.action: Kuro glides ahead into the cavern, his eyes projecting twin crimson searchlight beams cutting through the purple miasma.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Savdhaan raho. Yahan ki hawa mein Abyssal Miasma bhara hua hai.

panels.action: Breath puffs out in white vapor, yet Ha-Jun's skin feels pleasantly warm as sovereign blood circulates through his veins.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Itni thand mein bhi... mujhe garmi mehsoos ho rahi hai.

panels.action: They reach a colossal arched gateway guarded by twin 20-foot stone gargoyles holding giant ceremonial scythes.
As Ha-Jun passes between them, the gargoyles' hollow stone eyes suddenly erupt in roaring violet hellfire.
A massive 10-ton stone slab crashes down behind Ha-Jun with earth-shattering finality, sealing the exit.

panels.shot: turning back at seamless stone wall
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips around; the entrance has sealed seamlessly into solid basalt rock with zero cracks.
A radiant purple system window flares: [TRIAL OBJECTIVE: PURGE THE GUARDIAN GOLEMS] | [REWARD: 15% SYNC & BLOOD MANIPULATION].
Dozens of wall sconces around the vast circular chamber burst into purple fire simultaneously, illuminating ancient blood channels in the floor.
In the center of the arena stands a stepped obsidian sacrificial altar surrounded by glowing runic engravings.

dialogue.text: Ek prachin balivedi... jahan khoon ka daan diya jaata tha.

panels.action: Violent subterranean tremors rip through the chamber floor; deep cracks spiderweb outward from the altar.
Three 10-foot tall basalt Guardian Golems fused with demonic bone armor and glowing red rune cores rise from the floor.
The golems heft massive boulder-sized stone warhammers, their crimson rune cores locking onto Ha-Jun with lethal intent.
Kuro circles above: 'Yeh Sovereign ke Gatekeepers hain! Inka pathar kisi bhi aam hathiyar se nahi toot sakta!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dhyan se! Inka pathar aam hathiyar se nahi tootega!

panels.action: Ha-Jun smirks calmly, snapping his fingers: The crystalline purple demonic gauntlet locks onto his right arm with crackling magenta arcs.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Achhi baat hai... kyunki mera hathiyar aam nahi hai.

panels.action: The lead Golem charges with heavy thunderous strides, bringing its 5-ton stone hammer crashing straight down on Ha-Jun.
Ha-Jun steps forward and delivers a ferocious upward punch: His crystalline gauntlet meets the flat face of the descending 5-ton hammer head-on!
Cracks spiderweb instantly across the boulder hammer before it detonates into a thousand flying shards of stone.
Ha-Jun flash-steps inside the Golem's guard, driving his fist deep into the glowing crimson rune core on its chest.
The red core shatters; the 10-foot golem crumbles into an inert mound of fractured cobblestones and dust.
The remaining two Golems strike in tandem: One sweeps a wide stone blade at his legs while the second leaps from above with dual fists.
Ha-Jun expands his 5-meter Sovereign Domain: The falling airborne Golem freezes completely motionless mid-leap in mid-air.
Ha-Jun launches off the frozen Golem's shoulder, spinning into a vertical axe kick engulfed in blazing violet-crimson hellfire.
The flaming heel strike splits the second Golem cleanly from head to torso in an explosion of purple sparks.

panels.shot: blood claws decapitation of third golem
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands and extends Sovereign Blood Claws, slicing the retreating third Golem's stone head cleanly off its shoulders.
All three shattered rune cores turn into radiant streams of violet mana, absorbing into Ha-Jun's chest core.
Golden system prompt chimes: [TRIAL 1 CLEARED: BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION 15.0%] | [NEW POWER: FLUID BLOOD CONTROL UNLOCKED].
The central obsidian altar platform grinds open, revealing an ancient stone pedestal illuminated by a column of radiant scarlet light.

panels.shot: the ring of hollow blood cliffhanger
panels.action: Resting on a velvet cushion atop the pedestal is an antique carved silver ring embedded with a pulsating ruby tear: The Second Relic, Ring of Hollow Blood.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Doosra Relic... Ring of Hollow Blood.
